title: When "A or B" Is Less Likely than A: Coherent Probabilities for Vision Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30096v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision decision models answer a multiple-choice question about an image with one probability per option, and software uses them directly. We show that the probabilities depend on how the options are grouped: a merged option "A or B" receives on average 11.5 points less probability than the sum of A and B. This under-additivity appears at every model size from 0.85B to 26B and remains after fine-tuning on labels. We propose CORE, which asks each training question with its options regrouped and trains the answers to all these questions toward one target distribution over the original options, summed into each question's groups. On 1,050 items from seven benchmarks, CORE reduces the total variation distance between the answer to a regrouped question and the original answer summed into the same groups from 14.8 to 5.8 points on the 0.85B model, against 9.4 for the best baseline trained on the same questions. translated_title: 当“A或B”的可能性反而低于A时：视觉决策模型的概率一致性
translated_abstract: 视觉决策模型通过为每个选项给出一个概率来回答关于图像的多项选择题，软件直接使用这些概率。我们证明这些概率取决于选项的分组方式：合并后的选项“A或B”平均获得的概率比A与B的概率之和少11.5分。这种欠可加性在从0.85B到26B的每个模型规模上都存在，并且在标签上进行微调后依然存在。我们提出了CORE方法：对每个训练问题使用重新分组的选项进行提问，并将所有这些问题的答案训练到原始选项上的同一个目标分布，再按每个问题的分组进行求和。在来自七个基准的1,050个样本上，CORE将0.85B模型上重新分组问题的答案与按相同分组求和的原始答案之间的总变差距离从14.8分降至5.8分，而在相同问题上训练的最佳基线仅降至9.4分。在所有五个模型规模上，CORE……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现视觉决策模型的概率输出存在系统性不一致——“A或B”的概率显著低于A与B的概率之和——并提出CORE训练方法，通过选项重新分组的多问题训练使模型概率满足可加性，显著提升了概率一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that vision decision models are systematically incoherent—the probability assigned to "A or B" is significantly lower than the sum of P(A) and P(B)—and proposes CORE, a training method using regrouped questions with a unified target distribution, which substantially improves probability coherence across all model sizes.
